quality_rationale.difference: EDSANP discounts correlated evidence used to justify a covariance support mask and either allows or refuses the structured-support portfolio path; it explicitly does not infer/edit the support graph. SCCATF inserts covariance cross-terms into an allocation objective. SCIG changes the independence partition that determines multiplicative safeguard coverage before portfolio evaluation.
SACAPL changes CAPL risk-objective geometry while the feasible set remains fixed. SCIG changes categorical/common-mode evidence structure used by CSID, not portfolio covariance geometry.
SCOPG uses support geometry as an identification/conditioning guard. SCIG uses support-aware covariance to merge nominally distinct evidence families inside a safeguard-dependence model.
